raw_html: [[Nimbleness#Epic Nimbleness|Epic Nimbleness]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Nimbleness#Epic Nimbleness|Epic Nimbleness]]:''' This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a [[Maximum_dexterity_bonus|maximum Dexterity bonus]] 6 higher than normal, and its [[armor check penalty]] is reduced by 4.
